BOOK ONE · LESSON 131

Don't be so sure! 别那么肯定！

别那么肯定！

A dialogue lesson in which Martin asks Gary where he is going to spend his holidays and Gary explains that he can't make up his mind — his wife always worries too much, and in the end they stay at home and look after everything. The story introduces the modal verbs for possibility: 'may be/do' (present or future possibility), 'may have been/done' (past possibility), and 'might' (a less certain possibility than may). The workbook drills comprehension of the dialogue by completing it with the missing words and matching verbs with their partners; the grammar workbook completes blanks with 'may be/do' or 'may have been/done', answers questions with 'may' according to an example, and answers questions with 'may have …' according to an example.

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape then answer this question. What's the problem about deciding on a holiday? 听录音，然后回答问题。决定如何度假有什么为难的地方？

听录音，然后回答问题。决定如何度假有什么为难的地方？

  1. 1

    MARTIN

    Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?

    加里，今年你们打算去哪里度假？

  2. 2

    GARY

    We may go abroad. I'm not sure.

    我们可能到国外去，但我不敢肯定。

  3. 3

    GARY

    My wife wants to go to Egypt.

    我妻子想到埃及去。

  4. 4

    GARY

    I'd like to go there, too.

    我也想去那儿。

  5. 5

    GARY

    We can't make up our minds.

    我们还拿不定主意。

  6. 6

    MARTIN

    Will you travel by sea or by air?

    你们乘船去，还是乘飞机去？

  7. 7

    GARY

    We may travel by sea.

    我们可能乘船去。

  8. 8

    MARTIN

    It's cheaper, isn't it?

    这更便宜些，是吗？

  9. 9

    GARY

    It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.

    可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。

  10. 10

    MARTIN

    I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.

    我肯定你们一定会玩得很痛快。

  11. 11

    GARY

    Don't be so sure.

    别那么肯定。

  12. 12

    GARY

    We might not go anywhere.

    我们可能哪里也去不成。

  13. 13

    GARY

    My wife always worries too much.

    我妻子总是担心这担心那的。

  14. 14

    GARY

    Who's going to look after the dog?

    谁来照看狗啦，

  15. 15

    GARY

    Who's going to look after the house?

    谁来看管房子啦，

  16. 16

    GARY

    Who's going to look after the garden?

    谁来照料花园啦，

  17. 17

    GARY

    We have this problem every year.

    我们每年都碰到这类问题。

  18. 18

    GARY

    In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!

    末了，我们呆在家里来照看一切。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

Egypt /'i:dʒɪpt/
n. 埃及
abroad /ə'brɔːd/
adv. 国外
worry /'wʌri/
v. 担忧

Notes on the text 课文注释

1. We may go abroad.

在英文中用 may 来表示可能发生的事，在 may 后面加动词原形。请注意 may 表示的是一种可能性，这与第 127 课所讲的表示有根据的推论是有区别的。

2. make up our minds.

打定主意。

3. Don't be so sure.

别那么肯定。在祈使句中，be 动词的否定形式要用 don't be，这种结构常常用于劝告。

4. We might not go anywhere.

我们可能哪里也去不成。might 可以用来表示一种可能性，但它表示的「肯定」程度还不如 may。和 may 一样，might 所表示的是现在或将来的可能性。

5. look after.

照看。

6. in the end.

最后。
